Replan one read-only bounded program that dynamically parses all claims, directly recomputes every invariant, prints discrepancies, and calls sys.exit(1) when any discrepancy exists.

ALTER TABLE in SQLite is not easily reversible. This is irreversible, high-risk work that must remain human-gated.
